Twenty-five tasks, one week, and one founder doing all of them.
Time to find out which ones you can hand off.
In this exercise you'll build a delegation map.
Dump last week's work, one task per line with rough minutes, at least twenty lines.
If you don't have a business yet, use Groomer Books, a bookkeeping and invoicing service for independent dog groomers.
Then sort every task into three piles: agent alone, agent drafts and you approve, or only you.
If it leaves the business or touches money, it can't be agent alone.
Total the minutes in each pile.
Then pick the recurring task with the most minutes from the middle pile, and write it as a brief.
So: which pile holds the most of your week, and what's your first hire?
Pause here and build your map.
